page.overview:
Who is Dee?

Dee is a recurrent character in the Cthulhu Mythos works of the late American author Michael Shea.

An attractive 55-year-old gay woman, Dee is described in her first appearance as having

She often carries a heavy walking stick, although she acknowledges that this is for aesthetic and self-defence purposes, rather than as a result of any mobility issues. She has given it the ironic nickname of "Rod".

Dee enjoys walking in the hills surrounding her home in San Francisco, where she has taken in a lodger, a young woman who calls herself Scat. She is also the co-owner of a small independent bookstore named Treefrog - where she first came across Scat - and drives an aged Volkswagen Bug when she needs to.
